flightJourney.intro: First clarify what you need now, then preserve the travel record.
flightJourney.privacy: Your answers are not stored or sent.
flightJourney.title: Are you still at the airport or trying to continue your journey?

priority.title: Ask for the help you need now.
priority.body: Check the official channel of the airline operating the flight and ask for your options in writing.
priority.expenses: If the airline cannot or will not help, record what you asked for and keep itemized receipts for necessary, reasonable arrangements you pay for yourself.
priority.emergency: For a health or safety risk, seek local assistance immediately.

disruption.title: What problem did you have with the flight or baggage?
disruption.cancellation: The flight was cancelled or the schedule changed significantly
disruption.denied: I was denied boarding or the flight was overbooked
disruption.connection: I missed a connection or the flight was diverted
disruption.baggage: My baggage was delayed, lost or damaged
disruption.assistance: Required disability or reduced-mobility assistance was not respected
disruption.other: Something else or I’m not sure

connection.title: Were the affected flights on one reservation?

baggage.title: Did you report the baggage and receive a reference such as a PIR?

notice.title: Did the airline give you a written notice, reason or option?

result.title: Take the next step and preserve the evidence.
result.current: Use the operating airline’s official channel and ask for assistance or options in writing.
result.complete: Contact the operating airline in writing and keep its response.

evidence.booking: The booking confirmation and boarding passes.
evidence.messages: Airline messages and actual departure or arrival times.
evidence.choices: The reason, notice and options you were offered.
evidence.receipts: Itemized receipts for necessary, reasonable expenses.

type.delay: Keep the actual arrival time and ask for the passenger-rights notice.
type.cancellation: Ask for the options in writing; this page does not choose a refund or rerouting for you.
type.denied: Keep proof that you presented yourself and ask for the reason in writing.
type.connection: Keep both flight records and whether they were on one reservation.
type.baggage: Report promptly and keep the baggage tag and PIR reference.
type.assistance: Contact the assistance desk immediately; health and safety come first.
type.other: Ask in writing what happened and which options are available.

conditional.connection_yes: One reservation can be an important fact; this page does not decide your rights.
conditional.connection_no: Separate tickets may be treated differently; do not assume the same result.
conditional.connection_unsure: Check the confirmation to see whether the flights were on one reservation.
conditional.baggage_yes: Keep the report reference and check its status in the official channel.
conditional.baggage_no: Report it promptly; the relevant official deadlines can be short.
conditional.baggage_unsure: Check for a PIR or reference and report without delay if you do not have one.
conditional.notice_yes: Keep the notice and every option offered.
conditional.notice_no: Ask for the notice, reason and options in writing.
conditional.notice_unsure: Check your messages and ask for written clarification.

result.diasporaBody: The route, operating airline, booking and applicable rules need separate verification, regardless of citizenship or passport.
result.reform: EU rules are changing; the July 2026 changes do not apply yet. Check the current official source for your journey.
result.distinctions: Care, reimbursement and compensation are different questions; one does not prove another.
result.official: View official passenger rights — opens an external page
result.boundary: This orientation is free. Interdomestik flight-claim handling is not active in the current offer, and no case was created here.

noScript.title: Help with a flight problem
noScript.body: Contact the operating airline, ask for options in writing, and keep notices and receipts.
noScript.baggage: For baggage, report promptly and keep the tag and PIR reference.
noScript.emergency: For a health or safety risk, seek local help immediately.
noScript.boundary: Interdomestik does not open a flight case in the current offer.
